description: This file defines the FogBugz class and related classes to interface with the FogBugz API, including methods for login, logout, and API request handling.

classes.name: FogBugz
classes.description: Main class for interfacing with the FogBugz API, handling login, logout, and API requests.

classes.name: FogBugzCurl
classes.description: Wrapper class for cURL operations, managing HTTP requests to the FogBugz API.

classes.name: FogBugzCurlError
classes.description: Exception class for errors related to cURL operations.

classes.name: FogBugzAPIError
classes.description: General exception class for FogBugz API errors.

classes.name: FogBugzLogonError
classes.description: Exception class for login-specific errors, extends FogBugzAPIError.

classes.name: FogBugzConnectionError
classes.description: Exception class for connection errors, extends FogBugzAPIError.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FogBugz object, setting properties and initializing cURL.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Logs off from FogBugz if a token exists, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic API method calls by forwarding to _request.

methods.name: logon
methods.description: Performs login to FogBugz API and stores the authentication token.

methods.name: logoff
methods.description: Logs off from FogBugz API and clears the token.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Internal method to send requests to FogBugz API and handle responses.
